description: Reads a visible quest definition and the selected player's stored quest state. Missing quests return empty text, zero progress, and false state flags.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: quest
inputs.description: Visible quest ID for this player. Defaults to gather_logs. Use Find Quest or Quest List to choose another quest.

inputs.name: details
inputs.description: Shows the extra result fields in the editor. Does not change which values the operation produces.

outputs.name: quest
outputs.description: Selected quest ID, or empty text when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: quest_id
outputs.description: Selected quest ID as text, or empty text when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Selected quest title, or empty text when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Progress in the returned player state, or 0 when no state was returned. Reset returns the removed state's progress.

outputs.name: target
outputs.description: Progress required to complete the selected quest, or 0 when no quest was found.

outputs.name: progress_percent
outputs.description: Completion percentage from 0 to 100 when the result includes it. Reads and rejected or unchanged operations return 0.

outputs.name: active
outputs.description: True when the returned quest state is active. Reset describes the removed state.

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: True when the returned quest state is completed. Reset describes the removed state.

outputs.name: description
outputs.description: Selected quest description, or empty text when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: reward
outputs.description: Stored reward text. Does not mean an item was granted or a command was run.

outputs.name: required_level
outputs.description: Minimum quest profile level required to start the selected quest. Returns 1 when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: xp_reward
outputs.description: Quest profile XP awarded on completion, or 0 when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: permission
outputs.description: Permission required to start the selected quest. Empty text means no permission restriction.

outputs.name: world
outputs.description: World name required to start the selected quest. Empty text allows any world.

outputs.name: required_quest
outputs.description: Quest ID that must be completed before starting the selected quest. Empty text means no prerequisite.

outputs.name: max_active
outputs.description: Maximum active quest count allowed before starting the selected quest. Returns 0 when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: cooldown_seconds
outputs.description: Restart cooldown after quitting, in seconds. Returns 0 when no cooldown is configured or no quest was found.

outputs.name: scope
outputs.description: Definition scope: global, player, or permission. Empty text means no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: owner
outputs.description: Player UUID for a player-scoped definition. Empty text for global and permission scopes.

outputs.name: quit
outputs.description: True when the returned quest state is quit. Reset describes the removed state.

outputs.name: created_at
outputs.description: Quest definition creation time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Returns 0 when no quest definition was found.

outputs.name: started_at
outputs.description: Quest start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Returns 0 when no state was returned.

outputs.name: completed_at
outputs.description: Quest completion time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Returns 0 when no completion was recorded.

outputs.name: quit_at
outputs.description: Quest quit time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Returns 0 when no quit was recorded.

outputs.name: last_progress_at
outputs.description: Last progress update time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Returns 0 when no progress update was recorded.

outputs.name: time_to_complete_ms
outputs.description: Milliseconds between starting and completing the quest. Returns 0 before completion or when no state was returned.

outputs.name: active_time_ms
outputs.description: Milliseconds since starting while this quest is active. Returns 0 after completion, after quitting, or when no state was returned.

outputs.name: level
outputs.description: Quest profile level included with the action result. Returns 0 when the result has no profile details.

outputs.name: xp
outputs.description: Total quest profile XP included with the action result. Returns 0 when the result has no profile details.

outputs.name: xp_to_next_level
outputs.description: Additional quest profile XP needed for the next level. Returns 0 when the result has no profile details.

description: Finds the first visible quest by ID, title, or partial text. Returns Found and the quest ID, or false and an empty quest ID when nothing matches.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Quest ID, title, or partial text to search for. Empty text never matches a quest.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: How the quest is matched. id_title tries ID before exact title. id and title require exact matches. contains searches ID and title text.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when the operation succeeds or confirms an existing active or completed quest. False when it is rejected or has no successful result.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: True when a visible quest definition matched the search.

outputs.name: quest
outputs.description: Selected quest ID, or empty text when no quest definition was found.

description: Lists visible quest definitions and player states filtered by scope and status. Quest IDs are sorted without case sensitivity.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Quest scope filter. visible and all still respect visibility. owned selects this player's definitions. global, player, and permission select that definition scope.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Quest state filter. available excludes active, completed, and quit quests but does not check start restrictions. all includes every matching state.

outputs.name: quests
outputs.description: Visible quest definitions and player states as maps, filtered by Scope and Status and sorted by quest ID without case sensitivity.

outputs.name: quest_ids
outputs.description: Distinct visible quest IDs sorted without case sensitivity. Apply the same Scope and Status filters as Quests.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Number of distinct quest IDs returned by the list operation.

description: Reads the player's quest XP, level, and visible quest counts. Without a player, returns level 1, zero XP and state counts, and the total definition count.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: details
inputs.description: Shows the extra result fields in the editor. Does not change which values the operation produces.

outputs.name: level
outputs.description: Quest profile level, calculated as 1 plus total XP divided by 100 and rounded down. Returns 1 without a player.

outputs.name: xp
outputs.description: Total quest profile XP accumulated by this player. Returns 0 without a player.

outputs.name: xp_to_next_level
outputs.description: Additional quest profile XP needed for the next level. Returns 100 without a player.

outputs.name: active_count
outputs.description: Number of visible quests active for this player. Returns 0 without a player.

outputs.name: completed_count
outputs.description: Number of visible quests completed by this player. Returns 0 without a player.

outputs.name: quit_count
outputs.description: Number of visible quests quit by this player. Returns 0 without a player.

outputs.name: available_count
outputs.description: Number of visible quests without active, completed, or quit state. Does not check start restrictions. Returns 0 without a player.

outputs.name: quest_count
outputs.description: Total quests represented by this player's visible state counts. Without a player, returns the total number of definitions.

outputs.name: profile
outputs.description: Player quest profile as a map containing XP, level, counts, and visible quest lists. Without a player, returns default values and the total definition count.

description: Creates or replaces a quest definition with the same ID and scope. Player scope belongs to the selected player. Permission scope requires a permission. Existing player states are retained.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this quest operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Quest definition ID. Defaults to new_quest. Spaces become underscores, uppercase becomes lowercase, and unsupported characters are removed.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Quest title shown to players. Defaults to New Quest. A blank title uses the quest ID.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Text explaining the quest to players. Defaults to empty text.

inputs.name: reward
inputs.description: Reward text stored with the quest. Defaults to empty text. Completing the quest grants XP but does not execute this text as a command or give an item.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Progress needed to complete the quest. Defaults to 1 and is clamped to at least 1.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Definition visibility. global is shared, player belongs to the selected player, and permission is visible to players with Permission. Defaults to global.

inputs.name: restrictions
inputs.description: Shows world, prerequisite quest, active quest limit, and cooldown inputs. Hiding them does not disable their values.

inputs.name: progression
inputs.description: Shows required level and XP reward inputs. Hiding them does not disable their values.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.description: Permission required to start the quest. Empty text adds no permission restriction. Required when Scope is permission.

inputs.name: world
inputs.description: World name required to start the quest, matched without case sensitivity. Empty text allows any world.

inputs.name: required_quest
inputs.description: Quest ID this player must complete before starting. Empty text adds no prerequisite.

inputs.name: max_active
inputs.description: Maximum active quest count allowed before starting this quest. Defaults to 3 and is clamped to at least 1.

inputs.name: cooldown_seconds
inputs.description: Seconds to wait after quitting before starting again. Defaults to 0 and is clamped to at least 0.

inputs.name: required_level
inputs.description: Minimum quest profile level required to start. Defaults to 1 and is clamped to at least 1.

inputs.name: xp_reward
inputs.description: Quest profile XP granted on completion. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to at least 0.

inputs.name: details
inputs.description: Shows the extra result fields in the editor. Does not change which values the operation produces.

outputs.description: Continues after the quest operation, including rejected or unchanged results. Check Success and Reason.

outputs.description: True when the operation reports a saved change. False for rejected requests and unchanged quest state.

outputs.description: Result label such as created, started, progress, completed, quit, reset, deleted, allowed, active, missing, blocked, inactive, or xp.

description: Adds or sets progress on an active quest according to Mode. Progress is capped at Target. Reaching Target completes the quest and grants its XP reward.

description: Adds at least 1 progress to an active quest, capped at Target. Reaching Target completes the quest and grants its XP reward. Inactive quests are rejected.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this quest operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose quest state or profile is used. Uses the player running the flow when this input is empty.

inputs.name: quest
inputs.description: Visible quest ID for this player. Defaults to gather_logs. Use Find Quest or Quest List to choose another quest.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Integer progress to add. Defaults to 1. Values below 1 still add 1. Progress is capped at the quest target.

inputs.name: details
inputs.description: Shows the extra result fields in the editor. Does not change which values the operation produces.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the quest operation, including rejected or unchanged results. Check Success and Reason.

outputs.name: changed
